note: The FIRST real texture price of a mobile district, read off the user's own pak in Termux on the target phone with `scripts/debug/texture-budget.ts` (a manifest computation, not an engine run — no GPU touched). Pak: `build/district/pak`, buildTime 17:25 04-08-2026, built with `--rgba8 --max-texture 256` for a Mali-G51 that has no BC. 8 cell entries (a 2x2 district, hd+lod), 18 arrays, 663 layers, 21.4 M texels at mip 0. What it establishes: the format multipliers this bundle has been quoting are REAL on SA content, not just in theory — RGBA8 costs 8.5x what BC1 would and 4.2x what ASTC 4x4 would, on the same texels. That is the arithmetic behind 'a phone buys a district and not the map', and the reason plan 097 chain 2 turned to a direct ASTC encode. Layers by longest edge: 288 at 256 px, 197 at 128, 142 at 64, 28 at 32, 8 at 4 — so a further --max-texture cut still has somewhere to bite.
